source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot to BIOS setup menu
    2. Check the value of PI version in Main page

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that the BIOS Main page reports Platform Initialization version 1.7 for the target firmware build.
original_method: Enter BIOS Setup, capture the PI-version label and value on the Main page, compare it with 1.7 and the platform reference, and use firmware inventory only if an authoritative mapping to PI exists.
manual_activity: A human must observe the labeled PI field on the pre-OS Main page; a BIOS Revision line is not proof of Platform Initialization revision.
safety_requirements: Do not equate BIOS Revision with PI without documentation.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the 1.7 comparison and optional raw Type 0 evidence.
Report discrepancies without UI-action or verdict claims.
engineer_actions: Confirm PI 1.7 applies and approve window.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not equivalent: dmidecode BIOS Revision is not inherently the PI specification version.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep the exact command only as mapping-gated supporting evidence; do not substitute it for the UI check.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PI 1.7, the command and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the PI label/value with build identity and attach the platform document that makes 1.7 authoritative.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds applicability traceability and prevents BIOS Revision conflation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Generic revision inventory is semantically insufficient.

project_override_considerations: A project-approved build may expose a different PI level; document the override and do not claim the master 1.7 criterion was satisfied.
expected_evidence: Optional authoritative inventory mapping and raw output

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, procedure and criteria align on PI version 1.7. The duplicate code and DeepSeek field conflation are not primary-source contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The expected UI result is clear; platform applicability and console are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on manual UI evidence and 1.7 reference.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves master/project distinction and separates tool evidence from verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a matching generic BIOS Revision from falsely satisfying the distinct PI 1.7 UI requirement.
independent_technical_reasoning: PI version is a distinct specification datum rendered in a named BIOS page. With no proven machine-readable mapping, human UI observation remains the acceptance core and requires MANUAL ONLY.

no_automatic_retry: Do not re-enter Setup automatically after a mismatch or unmapped inventory result; preserve evidence and stop.
